Method.name: getConnection
Method.Implementation: Set tCredential=##class(Ens.Config.Credentials).%OpenId(..credentials) Set tUsername=tCredential.Username Set tPassword=tCredential.Password $$$TRACE(" user :"_tUsername) $$$TRACE(" tPassword :"_tPassword) Set classPath=##class(%ListOfDataTypes).%New() Do classPath.Insert(..jdbcJar) Set ..gateway=##class(%Net.Remote.Gateway).%New() Set status=..gateway.%Connect(..gateWayHostname,..gateWayPortNumber,,,classPath) $$$TRACE(" gateway "_status) Set status=..gateway.%ClassForName(..jdbcDriver) Set status=..gateway.%Import(..jdbcDriverManager) $$$TRACE("jdbcUrl:"_..jdbcUrl) Set url=..jdbcUrl,username=tUsername,password=tPassword Set ..connection=##class(java.sql.DriverManager).getConnection(..gateway,url,username,password) //do ..gateway.%Disconnect() $$$TRACE(" connection "_..connection)

Method.name: getMaxSeqNum
Method.Implementation: $$$TRACE("Inside Method Set MaxseqnumP1111") //Get the connection do ..getConnection() $$$TRACE("After Connection11") //Create Statement set query=pRequest.StringValue set ..seqStatement = ..connection.prepareStatement(query) $$$TRACE("After Statememt") // Execute mspr query set tResultSet = ..seqStatement.executeQuery() $$$TRACE("After Query Excted") while tResultSet.next() { set id = tResultSet.getString(1) } $$$TRACE("Current Max Id:"_id) set id = id+1 $$$TRACE("Incremented:"_id) set pResponse = ##class(Ens.StringResponse).%New() set pResponse.StringValue=id do pResponse.%Save() $$$TRACE("After values") //close the connection do ..connection.close() //Close the gateway do ..gateway.%Disconnect() $$$TRACE("After Close") quit pResponse
